LightningComponentBundle.description: Site header for the SignZero signing site: your logo (SignZero Branding) and company name (SignZero Settings).

property.name: logoUrl
property.label: Logo
property.description: Upload your logo. It is saved in SignZero Branding and also used in emails and on the Certificate of Completion.

property.name: faviconUrl
property.label: Favicon
property.description: Upload the icon for the browser tab. Without one, the logo is used. It is saved in SignZero Branding.

property.name: showCompanyName
property.label: Show company name
property.description: Company name comes from SignZero Settings.
